أستقطع (form X)
# أَسْتَقْطِعُ (ʔastaqṭiʕu) /ʔas.taq.tˤi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# أُسْتَقْطَعُ (ʔustaqṭaʕu) /ʔus.taq.tˤa.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# أَسْتَقْطِعَ (ʔastaqṭiʕa) /ʔas.taq.tˤi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# أُسْتَقْطَع
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
